scripts.version:bump: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json'));const parts=p.version.split('.');parts[2]=String(Number(parts[2])+1);const v='v'+parts.join('.');p.version=parts.join('.');fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2)+'\n');const html=fs.readFileSync('public/index.html','utf8');fs.writeFileSync('public/index.html',html.replace(/const APP_VERSION = \"v[\d.]+\"/,'const APP_VERSION = \"'+v+'\"'));console.log('Version bumped to',v);"
